introduction: This spec adds landscape awareness to the `spec` CLI's assessment and refinement pipeline, enabling the LLM to reason about all existing specs (active and archived) when evaluating a new PRD — detecting overlaps, suggesting dependencies, and surfacing historical precedent.

glossary.Assessment: Structured result type returned by `assess_prd()` and `refine_prd()` containing quality rating, gaps, and clarification questions.
glossary.PRDFrontmatter: Pydantic model in `afspec.models` representing parsed YAML frontmatter fields: `spec_id`, `spec_name`, `status`, `title`, and related fields.
glossary.SpecAgent: Class in `agentspec.agent` that wraps LLM calls for assessment and refinement, exposing `assess_prd()` and `refine_prd()` methods.
glossary.SpecMeta: Dataclass in `afspec.models` representing a discovered spec's metadata: `spec_id`, `spec_name`, `status`, and `dir`.
glossary.SpecSession: Class in `agentspec.session` that orchestrates the spec authoring pipeline, exposing `assess()` and `refine()` methods.
glossary._SPEC_DIR_RE: Compiled regex pattern in `afspec.discovery` (`^\d+_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`) used to identify valid spec directory names.
glossary._format_spec_landscape: New helper function in `agentspec.prompts` that converts the landscape list into a markdown table block for inclusion in LLM prompts.
glossary._load_frontmatter_only: Private function in `afspec.discovery` that reads and parses only the YAML frontmatter of a `prd.md` file, returning a `PRDFrontmatter` object.
glossary.af-spec: The Claude skill (`.claude/skills/af-spec/SKILL.md`) that guides an agent through the spec authoring workflow.
glossary.archive: Subdirectory under `spec_root` (i.e., `spec_root/archive/`) containing superseded or abandoned spec directories.
glossary.assessment_system.md: System prompt template for the assessment LLM call, defining the model's role and evaluation rules.
glossary.assessment_user.md: User prompt template for the assessment LLM call, containing the PRD text and landscape block.
glossary.assessment_user_prompt: Existing function in `agentspec.prompts` that builds the user-facing LLM prompt for `spec assess`.
glossary.current_spec_id: The spec ID of the spec currently being assessed or refined, excluded from the landscape results to prevent self-reference.
glossary.discover_specs: Existing function in `afspec.discovery` that finds all active spec directories under a given root, skipping the `archive/` subdirectory.
glossary.gap: A deficiency identified during assessment that prevents the PRD from reaching "ready" quality and requires resolution before proceeding.
glossary.intent: The content of the `## Intent` section from a spec's `prd.md`, or the first non-empty paragraph if no such section exists, truncated to 300 characters.
glossary.load_dependent_interfaces: Existing function in `afspec.discovery` that loads upstream spec interfaces for generation-time context; returns `[]` on failure.
glossary.load_prompt_template: Function in `agentspec.prompt_loader` that loads a named prompt template and performs `$variable` substitution.
glossary.load_spec_landscape: New public function in `afspec.discovery` that collects metadata for all specs (active and archived) and returns a structured list for prompt injection.
glossary.prd_text: The raw Markdown text content of a `prd.md` file passed to LLM prompt functions.
glossary.refinement_user.md: User prompt template for the refinement LLM call, containing the PRD text, QA answers, and landscape block.
glossary.refinement_user_prompt: Existing function in `agentspec.prompts` that builds the user-facing LLM prompt for `spec refine`.
glossary.spec_landscape: A lightweight summary of all existing specifications (active and archived) in the project, injected into LLM prompts to enable cross-spec awareness during assessment and refinement.
glossary.spec_landscape_block: Template variable (`$spec_landscape_block`) substituted into assessment and refinement prompt templates to inject the formatted landscape markdown.
glossary.spec_name: Human-readable name for a specification, used as a key identifier in prompt functions and metadata.
glossary.spec_root: The root directory containing all spec subdirectories (active and archived), typically `.agent-fox/specs/`.
glossary.\"\": The Python empty string literal, used as a fallback return value when intent extraction fails or when `_format_spec_landscape` receives empty input.
glossary.\"intent\": The dictionary key `"intent"` in a landscape entry, containing the extracted intent text for active specs; absent from archived spec entries.
glossary.\"ready\": The quality rating string indicating a PRD has passed assessment and is ready for artifact generation.
glossary.##: Markdown heading level-2 prefix, used to delimit sections in `prd.md` (e.g., `## Intent`, `## Background`).
glossary.## Cross-spec awareness: Section appended to `assessment_system.md` that instructs the LLM to check new PRDs against the existing spec landscape for overlaps, historical precedent, and dependencies.
glossary.## Dependencies: Optional PRD section listing cross-spec dependencies using a table of upstream and downstream task group references.
glossary.## Existing Spec Landscape: Markdown section header produced by `_format_spec_landscape`, containing tables of active and archived specs for LLM context.
glossary.## Intent: Markdown heading in `prd.md` that contains the spec's one-paragraph intent statement, used as the primary source for intent extraction.
glossary.### Active Specs: Subheading within `## Existing Spec Landscape` for the markdown table of active (non-archived) specs.
glossary.### Archived Specs: Subheading within `## Existing Spec Landscape` for the markdown table of archived/superseded specs.
glossary.$spec_landscape_block: Template variable in `assessment_user.md` and `refinement_user.md` that is substituted with the formatted landscape markdown (or empty string if no landscape is available).
glossary.None: Python's `None` value, used as the default for the `spec_landscape` parameter when no landscape data is available or when landscape loading fails.
glossary.[]: Python empty list literal, returned by `load_spec_landscape` on any error as a graceful-degradation fallback.
glossary._format_spec_landscape(spec_landscape): Call to the `_format_spec_landscape` helper, converting the landscape list into a formatted markdown string for prompt injection.
glossary.agent.assess_prd(): Method call on the `SpecAgent` instance within `SpecSession.assess`, forwarding the PRD text, spec name, and landscape to the LLM assessment pipeline.
glossary.agent.refine_prd(): Method call on the `SpecAgent` instance within `SpecSession.refine`, forwarding the PRD text, answers, previous assessment, and landscape to the LLM refinement pipeline.
glossary.archive/: Subdirectory under `spec_root` containing superseded or abandoned spec directories.
glossary.archived: false: Dictionary value indicating that a spec entry in the landscape list is an active (non-archived) spec.
glossary.archived: true: Dictionary value indicating that a spec entry in the landscape list is an archived/superseded spec.
glossary.assessment_user_prompt(): Call to the `assessment_user_prompt` function in `agentspec.prompts`, building the user-facing LLM prompt for `spec assess`.
glossary.async def assess_prd(self, prd_text: str: Updated method signature for `SpecAgent.assess_prd` with the new `spec_landscape` keyword parameter.
glossary.async def refine_prd(self, prd_text: str: Updated method signature for `SpecAgent.refine_prd` with the new `spec_landscape` keyword parameter.
glossary.discover_specs(spec_root): Call to `discover_specs` with the spec root directory, returning a list of `SpecMeta` for all active (non-archived) spec directories.
glossary.include_archive: Boolean keyword parameter of `load_spec_landscape` controlling whether archived specs are included in the landscape results (default: `True`).
glossary.include_archive=False: Calling `load_spec_landscape` with archive scanning disabled, returning only active spec entries.
glossary.landscape: Local variable holding the result of `load_spec_landscape`, passed as `spec_landscape` to the agent's assess/refine methods.
glossary.load_spec_landscape(self._spec_dir.paren: Call to `load_spec_landscape` from within `SpecSession`, using the parent of the current spec directory as `spec_root` and the current spec's ID for self-exclusion.
glossary.prd.md: Markdown file containing the Product Requirements Document for a spec, with YAML frontmatter and body sections including `## Intent`.
glossary.refinement_user_prompt(): Call to the `refinement_user_prompt` function in `agentspec.prompts`, building the user-facing LLM prompt for `spec refine`.
glossary.spec refine: CLI command that runs the refinement pipeline, incorporating user answers and re-assessing the PRD.
glossary.spec_id: Unique numeric identifier for a specification (e.g., `"01"`, `"02"`), used for cross-referencing and self-exclusion in landscape results.
glossary.spec_landscape: list[dict[str, Any]] | N: Type-annotated keyword parameter added to prompt functions and agent methods, carrying the landscape data through the call chain.
glossary.spec_landscape=None: Keyword argument passed to `agent.assess_prd()` or `agent.refine_prd()` when landscape loading fails, triggering graceful degradation.
glossary.spec_root / \"archive\": Path expression for the archive subdirectory under the spec root, scanned for archived spec directories when `include_archive` is `True`.
glossary.status: Field in spec metadata (both `SpecMeta` and landscape entries) indicating the spec's lifecycle state (e.g., `"draft"`, `"implemented"`, `"archived"`).
glossary.sys.exit: Python's `sys.exit()` function — `load_spec_landscape` must never call this, as it is a library function; errors are signaled via exceptions caught by the outer try/except.
glossary.title: Field in spec metadata containing the human-readable title of a specification, sourced from the `prd.md` YAML frontmatter.

user_story.benefit: the LLM can reason about the full spec landscape without manual discovery overhead

requirements.title: Overlap detection blocks "ready" quality in assessment

user_story.goal: be prevented from marking a PRD as ready when it overlaps with an existing active spec without acknowledgement
user_story.benefit: specs do not accidentally duplicate or conflict with existing work

acceptance_criteria.action: flags the overlap as a `gap` in the `Assessment` and generates a clarification question asking whether the new spec should depend on, extend, or supersede the existing one — preventing the assessment from returning "ready" quality
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returned `Assessment` contains at least one `gap` entry referencing the overlapping spec and at least one clarification question about the overlap
acceptance_criteria.state: a `## Existing Spec Landscape` section is present in the user prompt and the new PRD's scope overlaps with an active spec listed there

acceptance_criteria.action: notes the historical precedent in the assessment summary and asks whether the user is aware of the prior work and what has changed — but does NOT block "ready" quality on this basis alone
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returned `Assessment` contains a note about the archived overlap; quality rating is not forced to non-ready solely due to an archived overlap
acceptance_criteria.state: the new PRD's scope overlaps with an archived spec listed in the landscape

acceptance_criteria.action: suggests declaring a dependency on that spec in the PRD
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returned `Assessment` contains a dependency suggestion referencing the relevant spec
acceptance_criteria.state: the new PRD references capabilities already provided by an existing active spec

correctness_properties.for_any: call to `load_spec_landscape` that raises any exception internally
correctness_properties.invariant: `load_spec_landscape` returns `[]` and does not propagate the exception to the caller

correctness_properties.invariant: the function returns exactly `""` — the empty string

correctness_properties.invariant: the `intent` string has length at most 300 characters

correctness_properties.invariant: the entry dict does not contain the key `"intent"`

correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `assessment_user_prompt` or `refinement_user_prompt` without a `spec_landscape` argument

steps.action: runs `spec assess` for a new PRD
reads `prd_text` from `prd.md` and parses `spec_id` from frontmatter
calls `load_spec_landscape(self._spec_dir.parent, current_spec_id=spec_id)` to obtain the landscape list; on failure, falls back to `None`

calls `discover_specs(spec_root)` for active specs and scans `spec_root / "archive"` for archived specs, extracting metadata and intent for each; excludes the `current_spec_id` entry; returns the list or `[]` on any error
calls `agent.assess_prd(prd_text, spec_name, spec_landscape=landscape)`
calls `assessment_user_prompt(prd_text, spec_name, spec_landscape=landscape)` to build the prompt
calls `_format_spec_landscape(landscape)` and substitutes the result into the `assessment_user.md` template at `$spec_landscape_block`
receives the prompt including the `## Existing Spec Landscape` section, reasons about overlaps and dependencies, and returns a structured `Assessment`
persists the `Assessment` and returns it to the CLI; any overlap gaps are visible in the output
runs `spec refine` with answers to clarification questions
reads `prd_text`, parses `spec_id`, and calls `load_spec_landscape(self._spec_dir.parent, current_spec_id=spec_id)`; on failure, falls back to `None`
returns the landscape list (or `[]` on error)
calls `agent.refine_prd(prd_text, answers, previous_assessment, spec_landscape=landscape)`
calls `refinement_user_prompt(prd_text, answers, prev_assessment, spec_landscape=landscape)` to build the prompt
calls `_format_spec_landscape(landscape)` and substitutes it at `$spec_landscape_block` in `refinement_user.md`
incorporates user answers and landscape context, updates the PRD text, and returns an updated `Assessment` and revised PRD
writes updated PRD to `prd.md`, persists the new `Assessment`, and returns to the CLI

execution_paths.title: Graceful degradation when landscape loading fails

steps.action: runs `spec assess` while the spec directory is temporarily unreadable
calls `load_spec_landscape(...)` which raises an I/O exception
catches the exception, sets `landscape = None`, and proceeds
calls `assessment_user_prompt(prd_text, spec_name, spec_landscape=None)`
returns empty string for `None` input; `$spec_landscape_block` is substituted with empty string
receives prompt without `## Existing Spec Landscape` section and performs assessment in isolation — identical to pre-landscape behavior
returns the `Assessment` to the CLI; no error is surfaced to the user about the failed landscape load

error_handling.condition: Any exception raised during `load_spec_landscape` execution (file I/O error, parse failure, permission denied, etc.)
error_handling.behavior: Caught internally; `load_spec_landscape` returns `[]` without re-raising. `SpecSession.assess` and `SpecSession.refine` additionally wrap their call in try/except and proceed with `spec_landscape=None`.
`load_spec_landscape` treats the missing directory as an empty archive and returns only active spec entries; no exception is raised.

error_handling.condition: `prd.md` is missing or unreadable for an individual active spec during intent extraction
error_handling.behavior: The `intent` field for that spec entry is set to an empty string; the spec entry is still included in the returned list; no exception propagates.

error_handling.condition: `load_spec_landscape` is called from library code and encounters an unhandled error path
error_handling.behavior: Raises a Python exception (not `sys.exit`); the outer try/except in `SpecSession.assess` or `SpecSession.refine` catches it and continues with `spec_landscape=None`. The library never terminates the host process.
Returns an empty string immediately; `$spec_landscape_block` in the prompt template is substituted with empty string, leaving the prompt structurally identical to pre-landscape behavior.
